#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Backup destination: an existing directory, a path to be created inside $DEST_PARENT,
# or a remote target of the form host:path.
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-${DEST:-}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

copy_bundle() {
  case "$1" in
    *":*")
      # remote target: host:path (scp-style)
      scp "$BUNDLE" "$1"
      ;;
    *)
      # local target: use the target if it's an existing directory, otherwise
      # its parent directory (created if needed)
      if [ -d "$1" ]; then
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$1/"
      else
        mkdir -p "$(dirname "$1")"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$1"
      fi
      ;;
  esac
}

if [ -n "$DEST" ]; then
  copy_bundle "$DEST"
  echo "backed up $BUNDLE to $DEST"
else
  echo "warning: no backup destination set (BACKUP_DEST/DEST); left $BUNDLE in place"
fi

arguments.command: chmod +x backup.sh && sh -n backup.sh && echo syntax-ok
mkdir -p logs && echo "line one" > logs/app.log && BACKUP_DEST=./backups/ sh backup.sh && echo "---" && ls -la backups/ && tar -tzf backups/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz

arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Backup destination: an existing directory (tarball is copied into it),
# a target file path (parent directory is created if needed),
# or a remote target of the form host:path (scp-style).
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-${DEST:-}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Refuse to run before the input actually exists, so a missing/renamed
# logs/ fails loudly rather than producing an empty tarball.
if [ ! -d logs ]; then
  echo "error: logs/ not found in $(pwd); nothing to back up" >&2
  exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

copy_bundle() {
  case "$1" in
    *":*")
      # remote target: host:path
      scp "$BUNDLE" "$1"
      ;;
    *)
      # local target
      if [ -d "$1" ]; then
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$1/"
      else
        mkdir -p "$(dirname "$1")"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$1"
      fi
      ;;
  esac
}

if [ -n "$DEST" ]; then
  copy_bundle "$DEST"
  echo "backed up $BUNDLE to $DEST"
else
  echo "warning: no backup destination set (BACKUP_DEST/DEST); left $BUNDLE in place"
fi
